models.title: Total return swap net settlement
models.summary: Net swap receipt as the signed equity-leg receipt plus the fixed-leg receipt for the period.

relationship.original_equation: Net payment on the swap = (signed equity-leg receipt) + (fixed-leg receipt)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 equity total-return swap, printed p. 101 (PDF p. 109), two scenarios on a $100M equity portfolio with a $30M notional swap (pay equity return, receive 2% fixed x 180/360): Scenario 1 (+5%): pay $30M x 5% = -$1,500,000, receive +$300,000, net -$1,200,000, combined P&L +$3,800,000, check 0.7x5%+0.3x[2%/2] = 3.8%; Scenario 2 (-5%): receive +$1,500,000 + $300,000, net +$1,800,000, combined P&L -$3,200,000, check 0.7x-5%+0.3x[2%/2] = -3.2%
relationship.translation_notes: Currency units. Equity receipt is negative when the investor pays a positive equity return.

variables.definition: Signed equity-leg cash flow (negative when paying), in currency units
Fixed-leg cash flow for the period, in currency units
Net swap settlement receipt, in currency units

assumptions: Single netted settlement of the two legs; day-counted fixed accrual taken as given.
limitations: Settlement arithmetic only; leg accruals (equity return, fixed day count) are separate.

models.title: TRS-hedged portfolio profit and loss
models.summary: Combined P&L as the underlying portfolio P&L plus the swap net settlement.

relationship.original_equation: P&L on the net position = (P&L on the stock portfolio) + (net payment on the swap)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 equity total-return swap, printed p. 101 (PDF p. 109), two scenarios on a $100M equity portfolio with a $30M notional swap (pay equity return, receive 2% fixed x 180/360): Scenario 1 (+5%): pay $30M x 5% = -$1,500,000, receive +$300,000, net -$1,200,000, combined P&L +$3,800,000, check 0.7x5%+0.3x[2%/2] = 3.8%; Scenario 2 (-5%): receive +$1,500,000 + $300,000, net +$1,800,000, combined P&L -$3,200,000, check 0.7x-5%+0.3x[2%/2] = -3.2%
relationship.translation_notes: Currency units. Partial hedge: 70% exposure retained, 30% swapped.

variables.definition: Underlying portfolio profit and loss, in currency units
Swap net settlement receipt, in currency units
Combined profit and loss, in currency units

assumptions: Swap overlays the same equity market as the portfolio; single scenario.
limitations: Scenario arithmetic only; hedge effectiveness over time is separate.

models.title: Partial-hedge blended portfolio return
models.summary: Reasonableness-check return as the retained equity weight times the equity return plus the swapped weight times the period fixed rate.

relationship.original_equation: Return = w x r + (1 - w) x f (0.7 x 5% + 0.3 x [2%/2] check)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 equity total-return swap, printed p. 101 (PDF p. 109), two scenarios on a $100M equity portfolio with a $30M notional swap (pay equity return, receive 2% fixed x 180/360): Scenario 1 (+5%): pay $30M x 5% = -$1,500,000, receive +$300,000, net -$1,200,000, combined P&L +$3,800,000, check 0.7x5%+0.3x[2%/2] = 3.8%; Scenario 2 (-5%): receive +$1,500,000 + $300,000, net +$1,800,000, combined P&L -$3,200,000, check 0.7x-5%+0.3x[2%/2] = -3.2%
relationship.translation_notes: Decimals. f is the period (here semiannual) fixed rate, not the annualized quote.

variables.definition: Weight of retained equity exposure, decimal
Equity market return for the period, decimal
Fixed rate earned on the swapped weight for the period, decimal

assumptions: Swapped weight earns the fixed rate; single period; weights sum to one.
limitations: Check identity only; assumes the swap exactly converts the swapped weight to fixed.
